# Rise Personal

> Rise Personal is a personal branding agency for founders, executives, doctors, consultants and experts. Based in Dubai and working remotely, it serves clients in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, the wider Gulf, Egypt and Europe. Three pillars: personal branding, human-powered marketing and wellness (a lens about sustainable visibility and pace, not a medical or therapy service). It works in the room first, then on the record, then online, and every engagement starts under an NDA.

Facts: no office in Saudi Arabia or Egypt. Language today: English; Arabic is planned. We do not promise followers, rankings or revenue. Nothing is published about a client without their written approval. Founder: Mohamed El Sawaf. Contact: WhatsApp +971506832835 (https://wa.me/971506832835) or Authentic@risepersonal.com.

## Who we help
- [Personal Branding for Founders](https://www.risepersonal.com/for-founders.html): Rise Personal helps founders become the clear, credible face of their company with investors, partners, early hires and customers. We start with how you are introduced and remembered in the room, then put your story on the record and online in your own voice. We work under an NDA, so unannounced plans stay private.
- [Personal Branding for Executives](https://www.risepersonal.com/for-executives.html): Rise Personal helps executives and board members become known beyond the company they lead, with discretion. We work on how you are described in the room, what a search or a board committee finds on the record, and a light online presence. Nothing is public without your written approval, and we work within your employer's rules.
- [Personal Branding for Doctors and Experts](https://www.risepersonal.com/for-doctors-and-experts.html): Rise Personal helps doctors, consultants and other experts build a clear professional reputation within the advertising and conduct rules of their licensing body or professional association. We use your own words, avoid patient stories and before and after images, and you approve every piece. The final responsibility for compliance stays with you.

We work by email, video call and WhatsApp, with data protection in mind, and we confirm scope and price in writing before you commit.

## Journal
- [Personal branding explained, without the jargon.](https://www.risepersonal.com/journal-personal-branding-explained.html): Personal branding is the deliberate work of shaping how the right people see, remember and trust you, and making the evidence about you match that picture. It differs from corporate branding because it belongs to a person and travels with them, and from PR because it is a standing position, not a news moment. It is not a logo, a follower count or a performance.
- [Executive branding for CEOs and board members.](https://www.risepersonal.com/journal-executive-branding-ceos-board-members.html): Executive branding is the work of making a senior leader known and trusted beyond their own organisation, while respecting employer approvals, disclosure rules and confidentiality. It rests on a clear account of what you stand for, an accurate record that a search will find, and a small number of considered public moments. It is quieter than founder branding, by design.
- [Personal branding for doctors and clinics, inside the rules.](https://www.risepersonal.com/journal-personal-branding-for-doctors-and-clinics.html): Personal branding for doctors means building a clear, accurate account of your expertise and values that colleagues, referrers and patients can find, within the advertising and conduct rules of your licensing body. It uses your own words and general education, and avoids patient stories, testimonials, comparisons and before and after images. The final responsibility for compliance stays with the doctor.
- [LinkedIn for executives in the Gulf: profile first, activity second.](https://www.risepersonal.com/journal-linkedin-profile-executives-gulf.html): For an executive in the Gulf, a LinkedIn profile works as a reference page that people check before or after a meeting. A clear headline, a short About section that opens with who you help, an accurate role description and one consistent spelling of your name matter more than posting often. Activity should be steady, specific and approved where your employer requires it.
- [Founders and investors: prepare the person, not only the pitch.](https://www.risepersonal.com/journal-founder-personal-brand-fundraising.html): Before a fundraise, a founder's personal brand is the short, accurate account of who they are, why they started and why they are the right person to do this, supported by a record that a search will confirm. Prepare the story, the evidence and the materials so they agree. No branding work can promise a raise, a valuation or an investor's decision.
- [Human-powered marketing, with practical examples.](https://www.risepersonal.com/journal-human-powered-marketing-examples.html): Human-powered marketing is a way of marketing a company through the visible reputation of the people who lead it and speak for it, rather than through logos or product claims alone. In practice it means choosing a few people, defining what each stands for, and giving them a steady, approved way to share real expertise. It works when the people are willing and the company supports them.
- [How to build a personal brand without being loud.](https://www.risepersonal.com/journal-personal-brand-without-being-loud.html): You can build a personal brand without being loud by choosing depth over frequency, working in small rooms and in writing, and making yourself easy to introduce. Decide in advance what you will never share, and give people a short, accurate description they can pass on. A quiet professional who is easy to place often outperforms a loud one who is hard to remember.
- [Personal branding and burnout: visibility at a pace you can keep.](https://www.risepersonal.com/journal-personal-branding-and-burnout.html): Sustainable visibility means planning how often you speak, post and appear to match your real capacity, with boundaries around output and time to recover after demanding moments. At Rise Personal, wellness is a planning lens and a practice for leaders, not a medical or therapy service, and we make no health claims. A presence you can keep for years serves you better than a burst that stops.
- [How to choose a personal branding agency.](https://www.risepersonal.com/journal-how-to-choose-a-personal-branding-agency.html): Choose a personal branding agency by what it will write down, not by what it promises. Ask for a clear scope, who will do the work, how approvals work, how confidentiality is handled and what happens if you stop. Be wary of anyone who promises followers, rankings or revenue, asks for your passwords up front, or will not put the scope in writing before you commit.
- [Personal branding in the Gulf: introductions, gatherings and trust.](https://www.risepersonal.com/journal-personal-branding-gulf-introductions-trust.html): In many Gulf business settings, relationships and introductions carry real weight, so a personal brand is built first through how you are introduced and how you behave in gatherings, and only then through what appears online. Prepare a clear introduction, listen before you pitch, follow up with something useful, and make your online record match what people already hear. Treat this as a starting point, not a rulebook.

## Glossary
- [Personal branding: a plain definition.](https://www.risepersonal.com/glossary-personal-branding.html): Personal branding is the deliberate practice of shaping how people perceive, remember and trust you, so that your reputation is clear, accurate and consistent. It is not a logo, a follower count or a performance. Everyone has a reputation already; personal branding is taking part in how it forms.
- [Executive branding: a plain definition.](https://www.risepersonal.com/glossary-executive-branding.html): Executive branding is the work of making a senior leader known and trusted beyond their own organisation, while respecting employer approvals, disclosure rules and confidentiality. It builds a clear account of the leader's judgement, an accurate record and a small number of considered public moments.
- [Thought leadership: a plain definition.](https://www.risepersonal.com/glossary-thought-leadership.html): Thought leadership is the practice of sharing real, specific expertise so that other people learn something from it and come to associate you with a subject. It is earned by the usefulness of what you publish or say, not claimed by calling yourself a thought leader.
- [Personal brand archetype: a plain definition.](https://www.risepersonal.com/glossary-brand-archetype.html): A personal brand archetype is a recurring character pattern, such as the Sage or the Caregiver, that shapes how people instinctively read your tone, stories and choices. We use twelve. It is a positioning tool for consistency, not a personality test or a clinical or hiring assessment.
- [Human-powered marketing: a plain definition.](https://www.risepersonal.com/glossary-human-powered-marketing.html): Human-powered marketing is a marketing approach built on people rather than logos or product claims. Because people trust people, a company's most reliable brand is the visible reputation of the leaders, specialists and teams who speak for it. It complements advertising and data; it does not replace them.
- [Reputation management vs personal branding.](https://www.risepersonal.com/glossary-reputation-management-vs-personal-branding.html): Reputation management responds to and repairs what is said or found about you, often after something has gone wrong. Personal branding sets out in advance what you want to be known for and makes the evidence match. One is mostly defensive, the other mostly constructive, and they work well together.
- [Brand positioning statement: a plain definition.](https://www.risepersonal.com/glossary-brand-positioning-statement.html): A brand positioning statement is a short internal sentence that says who you serve, what you stand for and why you are credible, so every message you write agrees with it. For a person, it is the foundation for a biography, a profile headline and an introduction. It is written for you first and for the public second.
- [Personal brand audit: a plain definition.](https://www.risepersonal.com/glossary-personal-brand-audit.html): A personal brand audit is a structured check of what people find and say about you, compared with what you intend to be known for. It reviews search results, profiles, biographies and how others describe you, and ends with a short list of gaps to fix in order.
